agente.guainia: Guainía (Love · Relation): Invites encounter, attentive listening, reciprocity, and loving care for bonds between ancient rivers and hills.
agente.pacifico: Pacific (Lineage · Sound): Invites listening to the memory of ocean and jungle, recognizing our roots, and connecting with the sound of what precedes us.
agente.antioquia: Antioquia / Coffee Zone (Strength · Vitality): Invites activating your inner strength, transforming energy, and moving what requires action and creation.
agente.sierra: Sierra Nevada (Manifestation): Invites materializing, taking intention into conscious action, and giving tangible shape to what has been gestating.

landing_intro.descripcion:
At Ecodestinos we understand that not all trips feel the same.
Each territory in Colombia has a different energy and pace.

This experience map was created to help every traveler discover which territory can do them good today.

🌎 OUR VISION

We believe that traveling can also be a way to rest better, get inspired, reconnect, create, share, and feel more present.

introduccion.texto: In Ecodestinos, a destination is a living territory where nature and ancestral memory sustain unique energy.
